nodes.notes: Enacted in the signature from the naming commit on: Remainder <remainder@n-1.invalid>. The subject node keeps its id — a node is declared once and referenced forever; the id is history, not identity, and this naming is laid as an edge, never as a retouch. The repository's renaming is not assumed: it is the founder's act, requested the same session.

nodes.label: NAMING.md — the naming act: candidates weighed, longitude and latitude cited to committed evidence, subtraction stated, neighbours searched, daylight stated
nodes.notes: Written under a second pass (draft 112791b, revision 244acd3 — the diff the pass's evidence; six findings applied, one of them a quotation span whose ends were verified but whose middle was not, caught and verified whole). The name's ground: the practice is what remains — of a grammar written for persons, of sessions that end, of thresholds it lives under — and the strikes that shaped its law are subtractions whose originals stand. Nearest named neighbour: Tom McCarthy's novel Remainder (2005), a work not a practice, daylight stated in §7; no practice, collective, studio, journal or band of the name found by the session's dated searches.
